global_caption: The video contains 4 shots and presents a post-apocalyptic wasteland FPS game demo in a low-saturation watercolor picture book style. It uses a cool gray-brown color palette with subtle paper grain texture, primarily natural diffuse lighting with localized side lighting accents. The entire sequence maintains a first-person perspective, with the small gloves and homemade weapon intermittently appearing in the foreground. The crosshair, health bar, and ammo UI remain consistently stable and clear during running, picking up items, dodging, and aiming. The emotional tone evolves from lonely resilience to tense alertness, finally rising to a sense of hope.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, using a medium-wide first-person eye-level view. The foreground is occasionally framed by the edge of a glove and the lower barrel of the gun, forming leading lines. The midground shows the broken roof and rusted seats of a ruined bus stop, while the background reveals a deserted highway swallowed by wind and sand and a tilted road sign. Deep depth of field ensures both UI and environmental details are readable. Wind and sand sweep over faded car bodies; the watercolor-style edge bleeding makes the wasteland air feel dry. The girl child advances at a steady pace, with slight vertical motion in the view but the crosshair remaining stably centered. The health bar and ammo display remain clear without jittering. The camera gently pushes forward with minor inertial sway.

The foreground shows a small gloved hand reaching into a shelf gap. The midground includes toppled shelves, shattered glass, and a cash register. The background is semi-dark, with a beam of side light slanting in through a broken window frame, illuminating floating dust and the edge of the battery with soft white highlights. Composition uses diagonal shelves to guide the eye toward the picked-up battery. The camera first tilts down slightly to complete the pickup action. When the battery is lifted, the UI briefly flashes ammo and supply notifications before returning to stability. Then the gun is raised into stronger foreground presence, with the crosshair aimed at a dark corner deep inside the store. The action shifts from searching to alertness, with the hand raising the gun cleanly and decisively.
